title: Understanding k-Medians
text: In k-Medians clustering, the cluster centers are located at the median of their data points instead of the mean. This means that the center of a cluster is the middle value when the data points are sorted.

title: Initial Cluster Centers
text: The professors have initialized $$2$$ clusters centered at $$2$$ and $$7$$. Consider how the data points might be grouped around these centers.

title: Calculating Distances
text: Calculate the distance of each data point from the initial cluster centers (2 and 7). Which points are closest to each center?

title: Finding the First Merge
text: Identify the two closest data points that will form the first cluster. Consider the distances calculated from the initial centers.
